entries.title: Proverbs 12:1
segments: ¶A lover of training is a lover of knowledge; but a hater of teaching is like a beast.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:2
segments: ¶A good man has grace in the eyes of the Lord; but the man of evil designs gets punishment from him.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:3
segments: ¶No man will make himself safe through evil-doing; but the root of upright men will never be moved.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:4
segments: ¶A woman of virtue is a crown to her husband; but she whose behaviour is a cause of shame is like a wasting disease in his bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:5
segments: ¶The purposes of upright men are right, but the designs of evil-doers are deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:6
segments: ¶The words of sinners are destruction for the upright; but the mouth of upright men is their salvation.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:7
segments: ¶Evil-doers are overturned and never seen again, but the house of upright men will keep its place.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:8
segments: ¶A man will be praised in the measure of his wisdom, but a wrong-minded man will be looked down on.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:9
segments: ¶He who is of low position and has a servant, is better than one who has a high opinion of himself and is in need of bread.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:10
segments: ¶An upright man has thought for the life of his beast, but the hearts of evil-doers are cruel.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:11
segments: ¶He who does work on his land will not be short of bread; but he who goes after foolish men is without sense.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:12
segments: ¶The resting-place of the sinner will come to destruction, but the root of upright men is for ever.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:13
segments: ¶In the sin of the lips is a net which takes the sinner, but the upright man will come out of trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:14
segments: ¶From the fruit of his mouth will a man have good food in full measure, and the work of a man's hands will be rewarded.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:15
segments: ¶The way of the foolish man seems right to him? but the wise man gives ear to suggestions.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:16
segments: ¶A foolish man lets his trouble be openly seen, but a sharp man keeps shame secret.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:17
segments: ¶The breathing out of true words gives knowledge of righteousness; but a false witness gives out deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:18
segments: ¶There are some whose uncontrolled talk is like the wounds of a sword, but the tongue of the wise makes one well again.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:19
segments: ¶True lips are certain for ever, but a false tongue is only for a minute.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:20
segments: ¶Deceit is in the heart of those whose designs are evil, but for those purposing peace there is joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:21
segments: ¶No trouble will come to upright men, but sinners will be full of evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:22
segments: ¶False lips are hated by the Lord, but those whose acts are true are his delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:23
segments: ¶A sharp man keeps back his knowledge; but the heart of foolish men makes clear their foolish thoughts.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:24
segments: ¶The hand of the ready worker will have authority, but he who is slow in his work will be put to forced work.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:25
segments: ¶Care in the heart of a man makes it weighted down, but a good word makes it glad.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:26
segments: ¶The upright man is a guide to his neighbour, but the way of evil-doers is a cause of error to them.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:27
segments: ¶He who is slow in his work does not go in search of food; but the ready worker gets much wealth.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:28
segments: ¶In the road of righteousness is life, but the way of the evil-doer goes to death.
